fr_html: Le PRESIDENT propose l'addition suivante à l'alinéa 1: „et sauf acceptation par les parties d'une autre juridiction.”
en_html: The PRESIDENT proposed the following addition to Paragraph 1: “and unless the parties agree to accept another jurisdiction.”
